subject: english
stem: Listen to this report before making a decision. Which action is planned or required in the full message?
options: return only the tools from the activity kit
renew a late activity kit online
return the activity-kit parts on different days
return every part of the activity kit together

optionRationales.reason: return only the tools from the activity kit：此項把「every part of the activity kit together」改成「only the tools from the activity kit」。完整訊息指出計畫或要求的行動為「return every part of the activity kit together」。因此，鎖定證據支持「return every part of the activity kit together」。

renew a late activity kit online：此項把「return every part of the activity kit together」改成「renew a late activity kit online」。完整訊息指出計畫或要求的行動為「return every part of the activity kit together」。因此，鎖定證據支持「return every part of the activity kit together」。

return the activity-kit parts on different days：此項把「every part of the activity kit together」改成「the activity-kit parts on different days」。完整訊息指出計畫或要求的行動為「return every part of the activity kit together」。因此，鎖定證據支持「return every part of the activity kit together」。
return every part of the activity kit together：完整逐字稿明確支持此項。完整訊息指出計畫或要求的行動為「return every part of the activity kit together」。
